summary: All six SPEC items are implemented as specified. parseExample calls the existing heroPreflopProblems for built, non-preflop views after the field checks, with the 'Graded example <id>:' prefix. The unreachable guard is replaced by the narrowing cast from section 3. SPEC-05 fact-check: I reran the spec-writer prototype steps.ts audit and cat.ts on the new data. Gutshot Kd 4h on 7s 3c 6h is high card; its 4 straight outs are all fives, so it is a gutshot to the five, and Kc/Kh/Ks give top pair. The line is UTG/MP/CO fold, BTN limps, SB folds, BB (hero) checks its option, BB checks the flop and BTN bets. Hero step 6 is check, Correct (BB limpers K4o: check). Equity 26.8 vs required 22.2 gives minor call-fold-margin 4.6. Top pair Kh 7h on 9s Jh 5c Kc 8h is one pair. Best five is K K J 9 8, so the seven kicker doesn't play. There are only four hearts (no flush) and no straight. Steps 8-11 check the flop and turn. Steps 3 and 7 are Correct on borderline K7s cells. 56.9 vs 50 gives minor aggression-margin 6.9. Trips Ah 3c on Kd 3h 5c 3d is three of a kind with an ace kicker. The BB calls preflop, leads the flop (step 7 bet), hero calls, and the BB checks the turn. Step 4 raise is Correct (BTN unopened A3o: raise). 79 vs 50 gives major aggression-margin 29. All exact enumeration. Every claim in the three justifications matches, and no text describes the old hands. Like-for-like is confirmed in the diff: id, seats 6, street, userAction, grade, ruleId and marginPts are unchanged, and only holeCards, the gutshot's before and the justifications changed. The tests would catch a broken implementation. SPEC-01 replays each line independently and requires exactly 5 postflop examples, each with a hero decision. SPEC-02 pins the exact problem arrays, which would be [] without the new call. SPEC-03 checks fields and checkGradedExample null. The guard grep is clean, tests/ changes are only the two expected files, and npx vitest run tests/golden/ passes 292/292. One NIT.
